Welcome to ECHO

Offline song studio: write lyrics here, then hand off to an AI music tool for audio.

  1. Core — idea, theme, genre, hook → Write my song
  2. Story / Scenes — optional personal details & settings
  3. Copy AI music prompt — paste into Suno or ElevenLabs
  4. Export .echo.json — keep a full project backup
  5. Lead sheet — chords + timing for practice

Shortcuts: Ctrl/Cmd+Enter generate · Ctrl/Cmd+S save · Esc close panels
